source_facts: The existing restored-requester per-Gateway pLimit(2) expands into one shared background lifecycle concurrency=2 budget. Detached cleanup, cleanup tails, expired-delivery finalization, orphan resume reads and restored wakes use that owner budget; live requester wakes retain the bypass.

Canonical Gateway owner resolution and retired-owner limiter retention prevent a replaced Gateway from donating its capacity to old work. Detached wrappers retain task roots before queueing; dispatch still performs source/row/authority checks.

New source regression queues130 cleanup rows with a held mocked announcement: only2 start,130 roots remain, restart drain is marked, release permits FIFO start/dequeue order, eventual completion of all work and root count becomes0. This is in-process synthetic queue/drain evidence if the test is executed, not a real OS restart or provider run.
Source-switch tests narrow accepted rejection to the exact AggregateError text Queued registry write lost its original database, drain outstanding writes, and retain no-stale-hook/write assertions.
This shared background concurrency2 is distinct from previously observed dedicated recovery concurrency4.
author_reports_not_independently_reprodu: Linux synthetic rig with13000 sessions and6000 retained runs: baseline0/50 reconnects versus candidate50/50 twice, candidate cold requests16.09–17.28s and stormp99 13.08/21.16s. This reports availability under noisy contention, not a latency speedup.

Author measured production candidate699f8f… against baseline28f5f…; these differ from actual adjacent merge parent/head. Subsequent repair is test-only. 288focused tests and final12source-switch tests are overlapping reports, not additive unique tests.
Drain and database clean-close followed by usage-cache abort warnings do not qualify graceful process shutdown. Rig artifacts/logs were not inspected.
clusters.inference: A public next experiment is resource-bounded catch-up with simultaneous healthy-client reads, owner rotation and root draining. This is an independent hypothesis, not a private research-plan claim.
clusters.next_falsifiable_gate: Pin authentic adjacent parent and merge trees in a shipped Gateway, hold130 cleanup operations, verify exactly2 background dispatches and preserved task roots, healthy-client positive controls, correct old-owner capacity after replacement, current authority/row/source fences, eventual drain only after actual settlement, no stale effects; collect actual two-process-restart receipts. Reject for client starvation, extra slots, premature root release or stale writes.

source_facts: Owner/version/migration decisions move inside the existing synchronous schema write transaction. Schema-fact cache invalidation precedes rereading owner only after the writer lock is acquired; migration and maintenance authority decisions remain.

New deterministic source test uses two real nativeSQLite connections: a spy immediately before pending BEGIN IMMEDIATE commits winner agent-b through the actual schema owner path; pending agent-a must refuse, leaving owner and registry with agent-b.
Existing cross-process test is unchanged; it was not fully read or executed here. The deterministic new test is not itself a simultaneous two-process proof.

clusters.inference: Database ownership must be checked at the same serialization boundary as schema writes; a pre-lock read is insufficient evidence of current custody.

RequireA to refuse and preserveB state and durable receipts across reopen; include uncontended own-owner, authorized migration and maintenance positive controls. Reject owner takeover, stale registry or unexpected refusal of valid work.
